    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
is_carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM molecule m
        JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

WITH champion_time AS (
    SELECT MIN(time) AS min_time
    FROM results
    WHERE raceid IN (
        SELECT raceid
        FROM races
        WHERE YEAR = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    ) AND time IS NOT NULL
),

    FROM champion_time, last_place_time
)
SELECT 
    ((strftime('%s', inc_time) - strftime('%s', min_time)) / strftime('%s', max_time)) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM incremental_time, champion_time, last_place_time;

956.sql:
WITH d_cols AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob
    FROM drivers
),
d_rows AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob
    FROM d_cols
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', dob) > '1975'
),
r_rank AS (
    SELECT driverId, rank
    FROM results
    WHERE rank = 2
),
dr_filtered AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.rank, d.forename, d.surname
    FROM r_rank r
    INNER JOIN d_rows d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT forename, surname FROM dr_filtered;

971.sql:
WITH filtered_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverRef, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob IS NOT NULL
),
sorted_german_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverRef, dob
    FROM filtered_drivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC
)
SELECT driverRef FROM sorted_german_drivers LIMIT 1;

972.sql:
WITH d_birth AS (
    SELECT driverId, code
    FROM drivers
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', dob) = '1971'
),
d_fast_lap_max_filtered AS (
    SELECT driverId, MAX(fastestLapTime) AS max_time
    FROM results
    WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT db.driverId, db.code
FROM d_birth db
JOIN d_fast_lap_max_filtered df ON db.driverId = df.driverId;

996.sql:
WITH race_counts AS (
    SELECT YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_races
    FROM races
    WHERE date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
    GROUP BY YEAR
),
avg_races_per_year AS (
    SELECT AVG(num_races) AS avg_num_races
    FROM race_counts
)
SELECT avg_num_races FROM avg_races_per_year;

1003.sql:
WITH race_id AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
),
accident_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM race_id) AND statusId = 3
),
max_accidents AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS num_accidents
    FROM accident_drivers
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY num_accidents DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT num_accidents FROM max_accidents;

1013.sql:
WITH circuit_info AS (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM circuits
    WHERE name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
),
lap_times_filtered AS (
    SELECT l.lap, l.time
    FROM lapTimes l
    INNER JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
    INNER JOIN circuit_info c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE r.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix' AND l.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT MIN(time) AS lap_record
FROM lap_times_filtered;

1032.sql:
WITH league_with_most_matches AS (
    SELECT league_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY league_id
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.name AS league_name, lm.match_count
FROM League l
JOIN league_with_most_matches lm ON l.id = lm.league_id;

1036.sql:
WITH avg_build_up_play AS (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012' AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012' AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT avg_passing FROM avg_build_up_play);

1047.sql:
SELECT heading_accuracy 
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND pa.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

1082.sql:
WITH g_leagues AS (
    SELECT l.id, l.name
    FROM League l
    INNER JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Germany'
)
SELECT * FROM g_leagues;

1085.sql:
WITH crossing_stats AS (
    SELECT p.player_name, pa.crossing
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
),
max_crossing AS (
    SELECT player_name, MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing_value
    FROM crossing_stats
    GROUP BY player_name
)
SELECT cs.player_name, cs.crossing
FROM crossing_stats cs
JOIN max_crossing mx ON cs.player_name = mx.player_name AND cs.crossing = mx.max_crossing_value;

1087.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) 
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70;

1098.sql:
WITH ajax_teams AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM Team
    WHERE team_long_name = 'Ajax'
),
ajax_chance_creation AS (
    SELECT MAX(T2.chanceCreationPassing) AS max_chance_creation,
           T2.chanceCreationPassingClass AS classification
    FROM ajax_teams t1
    JOIN Team_Attributes t2 ON t1.id = t2.team_api_id
)
SELECT max_chance_creation, classification FROM ajax_chance_creation;

1158.sql:
WITH patient_birth AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1937'
),
cholesterol_data AS (
    SELECT L.ID, L.`T-CHO`
    FROM Laboratory L
    INNER JOIN patient_birth p ON L.ID = p.ID
    WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 250
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM patient_birth p
INNER JOIN cholesterol_data c ON p.ID = c.ID;

1161.sql:
WITH patient_age AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Admission = '+' AND strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday) >= '50'
)
SELECT AVG(Examination.`aCL IgG`) AS Average_aCL_IgG
FROM Examination
JOIN patient_age ON Examination.ID = patient_age.ID;

1182.sql:
WITH p_info AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE `First Date` = '1991-06-13' AND Diagnosis = 'SJS'
),
lab_test_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(ID) AS Total_Lab_Tests
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM p_info) AND STRFTIME('%Y', `Date`) = '1995'
)
SELECT Total_Lab_Tests FROM lab_test_counts;

1195.sql:
WITH patient_info AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
lab_info AS (
    SELECT ALB
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM patient_info) AND PLT > 400
)
SELECT AVG(ALB) AS average_albumin_level FROM lab_info;

1201.sql:
WITH patient_info AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.Diagnosis
    FROM Patient p
    INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1980' AND e.Diagnosis = 'RA'
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.ID) AS PercentageWomen
FROM patient_info p;

1213.sql:
WITH p_birthday AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday = '1982-04-01'
),
lab_data AS (
    SELECT ALP
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM p_birthday)
),
alp_range AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ALP) < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS NormalRange
    FROM lab_data
)
SELECT p_birthday.ID, alp_range.NormalRange
FROM p_birthday
JOIN alp_range ON 1=1;

1217.sql:
WITH birth_year AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1982'
),
albumin_range AS (
    SELECT L.ID, L.ALB,
           CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    INNER JOIN birth_year b ON L.ID = b.ID
)
SELECT ID, Albumin_Normal_Range FROM albumin_range;

1224.sql:
WITH max_bilirubin AS (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) AS max_value
    FROM Laboratory
),
high_bilirubin_patients AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.`T-BIL`
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.`T-BIL` = (SELECT max_value FROM max_bilirubin)
)
SELECT * FROM high_bilirubin_patients;

1247.sql:
WITH male_patients AS (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
),
wbc_normal AS (
    SELECT e.ID
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
),
fg_abnormal AS (
    SELECT e.ID
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450
),
male_wbc_normal AS (
    SELECT m.ID
    FROM male_patients m
    JOIN wbc_normal w ON m.ID = w.ID
),
male_fg_abnormal AS (
    SELECT m.ID
    FROM male_wbc_normal m
    JOIN fg_abnormal f ON m.ID = f.ID
),
count_male_fg_abnormal AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
    FROM male_fg_abnormal
)
SELECT answer FROM count_male_fg_abnormal;

1249.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis 
FROM Patient 
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

1266.sql:
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

1268.sql:
WITH sm_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
age_calculation AS (
    SELECT ID, Birthday, strftime('%J', 'now') - strftime('%J', Birthday) AS age_days
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM sm_patients)
)
SELECT ID FROM age_calculation
ORDER BY age_days DESC
LIMIT 3;

1272.sql:
WITH first_abnormal_patient AS (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
    ORDER BY p.`First Date` ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM first_abnormal_patient;

1278.sql:
WITH l_cols AS (
    SELECT ID, IGG
    FROM Laboratory
),
l_rows AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM l_cols
    WHERE IGG BETWEEN 900 AND 2000
),
p_join AS (
    SELECT e.ID
    FROM Examination e
    INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE e.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM l_rows) AND p.Admission = '+'
),
p_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
    FROM p_join
)
SELECT answer FROM p_count;

1291.sql:
WITH patient_info AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
),
albumin_protein_normal AS (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN patient_info P ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT albumin_protein_normal.ID) AS Male_Patients_Normal_Albumin_Protein
FROM albumin_protein_normal;

1293.sql:
WITH high_ana_patients AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.ANA
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
),
max_ana AS (
    SELECT MAX(ANA) AS max_ana_value
    FROM high_ana_patients
)
SELECT max_ana_value FROM max_ana;

1319.sql:
WITH m_vice_president AS (
    SELECT member_id, first_name, last_name, email, position, link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Vice President'
)
SELECT ma.college
FROM m_vice_president mp
JOIN major ma ON mp.link_to_major = ma.major_id;

1343.sql:
WITH food_budget AS (
    SELECT amount, remaining
    FROM budget
    WHERE category = 'Food'
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT remaining FROM food_budget;

1349.sql:
WITH event_info AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'September Speaker'
),
budget_amount AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event = (SELECT event_id FROM event_info)
)
SELECT total_amount FROM budget_amount;

1366.sql:
WITH e_cols AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'October Meeting'
),
a_cols AS (
    SELECT link_to_member
    FROM attendance
    WHERE link_to_event = (SELECT event_id FROM e_cols)
),
m_cols AS (
    SELECT first_name, last_name
    FROM member
    WHERE member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM a_cols)
)
SELECT * FROM m_cols;

1368.sql:
SELECT major_name
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.phone = '809-555-3360';

1411.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT expense_description
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_member = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison')
  AND expense_description IS NOT NULL;

1415.sql:
WITH m_cols AS (
    SELECT m.position
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
    WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business'
)
SELECT * FROM m_cols;

1430.sql:
WITH pizza_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member
    FROM expense e
    WHERE e.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND e.expense_date = '2019-09-10'
),
member_info AS (
    SELECT m.last_name, m.position
    FROM member m
    JOIN pizza_expenses pe ON m.member_id = pe.link_to_member
)
SELECT * FROM member_info;

1438.sql:
WITH club_members AS (
    SELECT member_id, first_name, last_name, email, position, t_shirt_size, phone, zip, link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Katy' AND link_to_major = 'rec1N0upiVLy5esTO'
),
club_major AS (
    SELECT T1.college
    FROM major AS T1
    INNER JOIN club_members AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
)
SELECT * FROM club_major;

1447.sql:
SELECT e.event_name, e.location 
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.remaining > 0;

1454.sql:
WITH meeting_expenses AS (
    SELECT SUM(expense.cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(event.event_id) AS total_meetings
    FROM expense
    JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
    JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
    WHERE event.type = 'Meeting'
),
meeting_percentage AS (
    SELECT CAST(total_cost AS REAL) / total_meetings * 100 AS percentage
    FROM meeting_expenses
)
SELECT * FROM meeting_percentage;

1466.sql:
WITH secretary_details AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS full_name, college
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
    WHERE m.position = 'Secretary'
)
SELECT * FROM secretary_details;

1467.sql:
WITH speaker_gifts AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, b.spent
    FROM budget b
    INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
),
total_spent AS (
    SELECT SUM(spent) AS total_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE category = 'Speaker Gifts'
)
SELECT t.total_amount, s.event_name
FROM total_spent t
CROSS JOIN speaker_gifts s;

1472.sql:
WITH ym_data AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency, y.TotalConsumption
FROM customers c
JOIN ym_data y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
ORDER BY y.TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

1479.sql:
WITH ym_data AS (
    SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', Date) AS Year, SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    GROUP BY Year
),
sorted_ym_data AS (
    SELECT Year, TotalConsumption
    FROM ym_data
    ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM sorted_ym_data;

1485.sql:
WITH customer_data AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date = '201304' AND CustomerID IN (5, 7)
)
SELECT (SELECT Consumption FROM customer_data WHERE CustomerID = 7) - 
       (SELECT Consumption FROM customer_data WHERE CustomerID = 5) AS diff;

1511.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Currency, t.Amount, t.Price
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, AVG(Price) AS avg_price
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
final_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS answer
    FROM c_rows
)
SELECT * FROM final_avg;

1527.sql:
WITH g_station_revenue AS (
    SELECT gs.GasStationID, SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM gasstations gs
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON gs.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
    GROUP BY gs.GasStationID
),
max_revenue AS (
    SELECT MAX(TotalRevenue) AS MaxRevenue
    FROM g_station_revenue
)
SELECT gs.GasStationID, gs.ChainID, gs.Country, gs.Segment, gr.TotalRevenue
FROM gasstations gs
JOIN g_station_revenue gr ON gs.GasStationID = gr.GasStationID
WHERE gr.TotalRevenue = (SELECT MaxRevenue FROM max_revenue);

1533.sql:
WITH filtered_transactions AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Price / Amount AS price_per_unit
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE ProductID = 5 AND Price / Amount > 29.00 AND STRFTIME('%Y%m', Date) = '201208'
),
consumption_status AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, ym.`Date`, ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN filtered_transactions ft ON ym.CustomerID = ft.CustomerID
),
final_consumption AS (
    SELECT cs.CustomerID, cs.Date, cs.Consumption
    FROM consumption_status cs
    WHERE cs.Date = '201208'
)
SELECT * FROM final_consumption;
